# Parker & Sons

> Parker & Sons is a full-service HVAC, plumbing, and electrical contractor serving Phoenix and Arizona with 50+ years of trusted experience and 24/7 emergency service.

Founded in 1974, Parker & Sons is a BBB Trust Certified company providing residential and commercial services across the Phoenix metro area, Tucson, and surrounding Arizona communities. The company specializes in air conditioning, heating, indoor air quality, and maintenance agreements with financing options available.

- HVAC Services

## Core Services

- [Air Conditioning Services](https://www.parkerandsons.com/cooling): AC repair, maintenance, and installation services in Phoenix
- [AC Repair](https://www.parkerandsons.com/cooling/ac-repair): Fast, affordable AC repair services across Arizona with 50+ years experience
- [AC Installation](https://www.parkerandsons.com/cooling/ac-installation): Energy-efficient AC installation and replacement with warranty coverage
- [AC Tune-Up](https://www.parkerandsons.com/cooling/ac-tune-up): 40-point AC tune-up service for optimal performance and efficiency
- [Heating Services](https://www.parkerandsons.com/heating): Furnace and heating repair, installation, maintenance in Phoenix
- [Heating Repair](https://www.parkerandsons.com/heating/heating-repair): 24-hour emergency heating and furnace repair for Phoenix metro area
- [Heating Installation](https://www.parkerandsons.com/heating/heating-installation): Furnace and heating system installation with SEER efficiency ratings
- [Heating Tune-Up](https://www.parkerandsons.com/heating/heating-tune-up): 40-point heating system tune-up for optimal performance and efficiency
